newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks turn flat in London amid weak Dow.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks turn flat in London amid weak Dow.

text.p: Most Hong Kong shares erased early losses in London and were trading near their Hong Kong closing levels, following a downward draft in the U.S. stock and bond markets, dealers said.
At 1415 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference indicator was down 25.56 points to 12,555.75.

Early activity saw shares in HSBC Holdings edge higher with London stocks, but stronger-than-expected U.S. industrial production and capacity utilisation figures dragged the shares lower later in the session, dealers said.
Property stocks, which had been under pressure in recent sessions, bounced in early dealings, but also saw their gains pared as the Dow drifted lower.
"We're just tracking Wall Street," a London dealer said.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index rose 239.29 points, or 1.9 percent, to 12,581.31.
